title_sq: Shitet Apartament 3+1 ne Astir prane unazes
description_sq:

title_en: Apartment 3+1 for sale in Astir near the ring road
description_en: Apartment 3+1 for sale in Astir near the ring road. with a construction area of ​​132m2 with a mortgage, on the 5th floor of a new building with an elevator. The property has a very functional organization: 3 bedrooms, living room; distribution corridor of all rooms; 3 toilets (one with window), balcony with exit from the living room. Property specifications: The apartment is fully invested with parquet, hood system, thermal insulation, plastic windows with triple glazing. The apartment is sold empty.
